milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron door is at spawn-relative (1, 1, 4). max_distance=16 is acceptable here since this is the FIRST task in the chain — the door is close to spawn (~5 blocks) and the agent just needs to turn and face it. The facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the door.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cauldron is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5) inside the first room behind the exterior stone brick wall. Even with max_distance=16, the agent must enter the building to face the cauldron since the exterior walls block line-of-sight from outside. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the cauldron.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red bed is at spawn-relative (10, 0, 8) in the inner room behind the dividing wall at x=7. max_distance reduced to 8 (per Validator recommendation) to ensure the agent has actually entered or is very close to the inner room, rather than just glimpsing the bed through the doorway from the first room. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the bed.
